purpose: Deterministic query-to-anchor lexical resolution followed by index-discovered dependency retrieval.
independent_hash_check: Embedded result_data_sha256 matches independently recomputed canonical JSON hash.
break_even: The measured persistent index cost is not recovered at batch size 1, but is recovered by batch size 4 in all three variants in this benchmark.
caveats: Anchor resolution is deterministic lexical matching of literal state IDs in the query text; natural-language semantic query understanding is not tested.
The structural index discovers dependency closure after anchor resolution; closure correctness is validated against an independently computed ground truth.
Index storage is a persistent one-time cost amortized across repeated queries.
The selected transport re-encodes induced subsets with the same encoders; this is not a fully chunk-addressable wire protocol.
No latency, learned retrieval, LLM semantic equivalence, universal generalization, consciousness, or optimality claim is made.
